name: Ostrogorsk
historical_basis: Voronezh axis, late summer 1943: a small railway city behind the Ostrogozhsk-Rossosh line - a fictional city composed for mirror fairness; no specific engagement is depicted.
design_notes: city + open outskirts hybrid: a dense masonry city on the west bench, open field patchwork and a north-south rail embankment on the east, the boulevard square between them - every playstyle gets its flank
the berm is the east wall: 7 m of fill exceeding the climb grade everywhere except three gates (the level crossing on the axis, two mirrored underpass cuts) - the eastern routes ARE the gates

DENSE CORE stage (urban-map program PR-12): 48-block CityBuilding tenement grid in cobbled street canyons, mirrored factory compounds behind breachable StoneWall yards, born-ruin pairs opening cross-block sightlines, garden walls screening the boulevard seam - outskirts polish follows in PR-13

features.name: city of Ostrogorsk
features.note: the west bench carries the whole city: street canyons, the church square, the mill compounds - the close-quarters flank

features.name: the mainline berm
features.note: 7 m of fill above the climb grade: the east wall of the map - passable only at the level crossing and the two underpass cuts

features.name: the level crossing
features.note: the axis gate through the berm, pre-marked by the wreck pair - the long-range door to the far fields

features.name: boulevard square
features.note: where the city meets the open flank: the capture zone and the hinge every rotation passes through

features.name: east fields
features.note: worked patchwork between the boulevard and the berm: the open flank, overwatched from the rises and the elevators
